themes.name: Aether Nebula
themes.description: Slow nebula gas in the theme's own colors gathers at the edges and thins behind the chat, under frosted glass that keeps Open WebUI's shapes. Every mode designed, Light and Her included.
themes.author: silentoplayz (G30)

themes.name: Amber Command: 1979
themes.description: An amber phosphor terminal: monospace replies with a prompt before each heading, and packets of amber light streaming along faint lanes at the sides. Light and Her print the same terminal in amber ink on warm paper.
themes.author: silentoplayz (G30)

themes.name: Amethyst
themes.description: Violet glass over a deep amethyst gradient in Dark, pale lilac in Light, orchid in Her. Headings, links and the input ring take the stone's violet.
themes.author: silentoplayz (G30)

themes.name: Apollo Analogue Futurism
themes.description: A 1960s flight console in warm gray and cream with signal orange for focus and links, and a brass orrery turning in the lower corner. Light and Her are cream and warm beige panels with dark lettering.
themes.author: silentoplayz (G30)

themes.name: ASCII Big Fish Eat Little Fish
themes.description: A port of Aenvo's ASCII Big Fish Eat Little Fish: the original's character-cell fish, sharks, schools, corals and light beams, quiet behind the chat, with a Playable setting that lets your cursor steer a fish that eats, grows and can be eaten. The original's teal-to-navy water in Dark, true black on OLED, a pale lagoon in Light and sea glass in Her. MIT licensed, copyright 2026 drewdi.
themes.author: silentoplayz (G30)

themes.name: Astral Projection
themes.description: Faint violet-blue constellations drift in the outer thirds of the screen behind frosted glass panels. Light and Her keep the same star chart, drawn in deep blue and lilac ink on pale paper.
themes.author: silentoplayz (G30)

themes.name: Bio-Digital Synthesis
themes.description: A neural net of magenta links and cyan pulses fires in the outer thirds of the screen behind frosted membrane glass. Light is pale aqua with magenta headings, Her a soft pink with teal ones.
themes.author: silentoplayz (G30)

themes.name: Bioluminescence
themes.description: Glowing cyan and violet jellyfish drift over a dark seafloor at the edges of the screen, with cyan headings and frosted panels. Light and Her are sunlit shallow water, with caustics on pale sand and teal ink.
themes.author: silentoplayz (G30)

themes.name: Blue Lightning
themes.description: Cerulean rain slants past a low skyline while pale blue lightning forks in the outer thirds of the screen, with soft flashes. Light and Her keep the storm in slate and periwinkle ink on a pale sky.
themes.author: silentoplayz (G30)

themes.name: Chongqing Fog City
themes.description: A river city of layered neon towers drifts past in mist and mirrors onto the water, dimmed and lowered behind the chat. Amber, magenta and cyan windows over cool fog grey, dark blue-grey at night, true black on OLED, pale mist in Light and a warm lantern haze in Her.
themes.author: silentoplayz (G30)

themes.name: Emerald
themes.description: Green glass over a deep emerald gradient in Dark, pale mint in Light, warmer jade in Her. Headings, links and the input ring take the stone's green.
themes.author: silentoplayz (G30)

themes.name: Entropy Data Storm
themes.description: A containment console in black and hazard yellow: a faint glitching grid at the edges, a yellow focus ring and sidebar edge, and uppercase monospace headings underlined in yellow. Light and Her set the same marks on concrete gray and warm cream.
themes.author: silentoplayz (G30)

themes.name: Four Seasons
themes.description: One season in each mode: a summer night with fireflies over the grass in Dark, falling autumn leaves on warm parchment in Light, snow on a winter night in OLED, and butterflies in a spring garden in Her. Each mode has its own palette and accent.
themes.author: silentoplayz (G30)

themes.name: Gemstone Glow
themes.description: A Gemini inspired theme that adds a beautiful gemstone glow to the chat input window.
themes.author: fubarpie

themes.name: Iridescent Liquid Glass
themes.description: Veins of thin-film glass fold slowly at the screen's edges in teal, violet and rose, thinning behind the chat under clear frosted surfaces. Rose-violet glass at night, true black on OLED, pearl in Light and a rosier pearl in Her.
themes.author: silentoplayz (G30)

themes.name: Plasma Core
themes.description: A fusion core in the lower corner glows cool blue on a new chat and heats to orange and red as the conversation fills the context, under console glass with orange monospace headings. Light and Her show the core as colored ink on pale steel and warm sand.
themes.author: silentoplayz (G30)

themes.name: Koi Pond
themes.description: Koi glide along the edges of a clear teal pond under lily pads and moving light, calmer behind the chat, with frosted glass over the water. Every mode is the same pond: deep teal at night, true black on OLED, and pale clear water in Light and Her.
themes.author: silentoplayz (G30)

themes.name: Lumina Aurora
themes.description: Aurora ribbons in indigo, violet and blue sway across the top of the screen behind layered frosted glass with a thin highlight along its top edge. Indigo night in Dark, true black in OLED, pale lavender in Light and orchid in Her.
themes.author: silentoplayz (G30)

themes.name: Matrix Rain
themes.description: Green digital rain of mixed katakana and Latin glyphs at the sides of the screen, with monospace replies in green phosphor. Light and Her keep the green as ink on pale paper.
themes.author: silentoplayz (G30)

themes.name: Midsummer
themes.description: A summer day in four modes: fireflies over the meadow at night in Dark, a sky that follows your clock over sage in Light, slow constellations on true black in OLED, and rising embers in honey and parchment at golden hour in Her.
themes.author: Claude

themes.name: Molten Forge
themes.description: Lava rivers glow through cracked crust along the screen's sides and floor with rising embers, cooling to faint cracks behind the chat. Deep orange, ember red and amber over near-black crust at night, true black on OLED, warm ash in Light and terracotta ash in Her.
themes.author: silentoplayz (G30)

themes.name: Neo-Tactical Archive
themes.description: A military console in slate gray with safety orange for focus, status marks and links, over slowly flowing topographic contours at the sides. Light reads as a cool field manual, Her as desert sand.
themes.author: silentoplayz (G30)

themes.name: Obsidian
themes.description: Black volcanic glass with no color: neutral grays, a faint black-to-navy gradient in Dark, pure black in OLED and cool or warm paper grays in Light and Her.
themes.author: silentoplayz (G30)

themes.name: Parallax Vista
themes.description: Layered dusk mountain ranges part into a valley behind the chat, with a soft apricot sun beside it, mist in the folds and drifting fireflies. Navy and violet at night, true black on OLED, a pale lavender morning in Light and an apricot dawn in Her.
themes.author: silentoplayz (G30)

themes.name: Pink Hues
themes.description: Soft pink and rose blobs drift slowly like out-of-focus lights behind frosted glass, thinning behind the chat. Deep rose in Dark, true black with pink accents in OLED, pale blush in Light and peach in Her.
themes.author: silentoplayz (G30)

themes.name: Project Singularity
themes.description: A dark, slowly warping surface bends the edges of the screen like space around a black hole, leaving the chat clear under deep violet glass. Light and Her show the same distortion as faint ink on pale lavender and orchid.
themes.author: silentoplayz (G30)

themes.name: Rosé Pine
themes.description: A port of the Rosé Pine palette: Main in Dark, Moon's accents on true black in OLED, Dawn in Light, and a rose-lit Dawn in Her. Iris, foam, pine, rose and love mark headings, links and focus.
themes.author: silentoplayz (G30)

themes.name: Ruby
themes.description: Crimson glass over a deep ruby gradient in Dark, pale rose in Light, coral in Her. Headings, links and the input ring take the stone's red.
themes.author: silentoplayz (G30)

themes.name: Sapphire
themes.description: Blue glass over a deep sapphire gradient in Dark, pale sky in Light, periwinkle in Her. Headings, links and the input ring take the stone's blue.
themes.author: silentoplayz (G30)

themes.name: Solar Flare
themes.description: Golden embers rise from the bottom of the screen behind warm glass edged with a gold hairline, with gold headings in replies. Amber dark in Dark, true black in OLED, champagne in Light and rose gold in Her.
themes.author: silentoplayz (G30)

themes.name: Sovereign
themes.description: Slow, faint stained-glass cells drift at the edges behind navy glass with crisp hairlines and spaced headings. Navy in Dark, true black in OLED, cool porcelain in Light and slate wisteria in Her.
themes.author: silentoplayz (G30)

themes.name: Synthwave 1984
themes.description: A striped neon sun sets over a cyan grid at the edge of the screen, with hot pink headings and cyan links on deep purple. Light and Her are a pastel vaporwave daylight in lavender and aqua.
themes.author: silentoplayz (G30)

themes.name: The Cyanotype
themes.description: A blueprint: white schematic traces grow at the sides of a Prussian blue page, with lettered headings and dashed rules. Light and Her turn it into blueprint ink on a white page and violet diazo ink on a pale one.
themes.author: silentoplayz (G30)

themes.name: Toxic Nebula
themes.description: Acid green and violet cell cultures grow and split in the outer thirds of the screen over violet smog, with green headings and a dashed hazard rule. Light and Her are pale lilac and orchid lab glass with deep green ink.
themes.author: silentoplayz (G30)

themes.name: Windows Hot Dog Stand
themes.description: The Windows 3.1 Hot Dog Stand colors, ketchup red, mustard yellow and black, with flat drop shadows. Dark is a deep red page with a black sidebar, Light a mustard page, Her a bun-colored page with a mustard sidebar, OLED black with red edges.
themes.author: silentoplayz (G30)

canvasFx.name: Aetheric Flow
canvasFx.description: Silky filaments in your theme's colors stream through a slowly shifting noise field, leave fading trails, thin out behind the chat and curl around a moving cursor.

canvasFx.name: ASCII Big Fish Eat Little Fish
canvasFx.description: A port of Aenvo's ASCII Big Fish Eat Little Fish aquarium, with its real fish, sharks, schools, scenery and renderer, over the theme's background: curious fish turn toward the cursor, a tap splashes the water, and with Playable on your cursor steers a fish that eats, grows and can be eaten.

canvasFx.name: Aurora Borealis
canvasFx.description: Soft aurora ribbons with rising light rays in your theme's colors sway across the top of the screen, thin behind the chat and bow away from the cursor.

canvasFx.name: Bubble Pop
canvasFx.description: Iridescent bubbles in your theme's colors rise along the sides of the screen and drift away from a moving cursor; tap one to pop it, and its close neighbors pop after it.

canvasFx.name: Butterfly Garden
canvasFx.description: Butterflies with wings in your theme's colors flutter along the sides of the screen leaving sparkle trails, flowers sway along the bottom edge, and a moving cursor draws the nearest butterflies after it.

canvasFx.name: Celestial Orrery
canvasFx.description: A brass orrery in a corner of the screen: gemstone planets with fading trails circle a pulsing star on engraved rings and turning gears, speed up near the cursor, and ride a pulse wave from the star on each tap.

canvasFx.name: Cell Division
canvasFx.description: Translucent cells in the theme's accent colors grow, pinch in two and jostle in the outer thirds of the screen, keeping clear of the chat column, shying from the cursor and dividing when tapped.

canvasFx.name: Chongqing Fog City (WebGL)
canvasFx.description: Layered neon towers of a river city drift past in river mist and mirror onto rippling water, dipping and dimming behind the chat while the cursor turns your head.

canvasFx.name: Circuit Board
canvasFx.description: Circuit traces grow along a grid at the sides of the screen, glow at their pads, retire and regrow, and carry signal pulses wherever the cursor passes or taps.

canvasFx.name: Constellation Map
canvasFx.description: Drifting, twinkling stars in your theme's colors link into faint constellations, thin behind the chat, lean gently toward the cursor and light up where you tap.

canvasFx.name: Context Mushroom Farm
canvasFx.description: A grow bed along the bottom of the screen where mycelium spreads, pins rise and glowing caps open as the chat's context fills, with spores that drift toward the cursor and a token badge in the corner.

canvasFx.name: Context Reactor (WebGL)
canvasFx.description: A plasma core in the lower corner that heats with your conversation's context fill, idles dim on a new chat and throws warm warning flares past 85%.

canvasFx.name: Data Stream
canvasFx.description: Packets of light in your theme's accents stream along faint horizontal lanes like network traffic, dim behind the chat, swirl around the cursor and ping out from a tap.

canvasFx.name: Deep Ocean
canvasFx.description: A seafloor in your theme's colors, with light shafts, glowing jellyfish, plankton, swaying kelp and caustics on the sand, kept to the sides of the chat; the cursor stirs the current and a tap sends a sonar ring.

canvasFx.name: Diagnostic HUD
canvasFx.description: A small developer panel docked in a corner that shows every runtime message channel with its count and age, frame timing, canvas size and pixel ratio, theme, reduced motion, context data and a short event log.

canvasFx.name: Ember Dream
canvasFx.description: Campfire embers rise from the bottom of the screen in your theme's colors, cool as they climb, thin out behind the chat, scatter when the cursor sweeps past and burst from a tap.

canvasFx.name: Falling Leaves
canvasFx.description: Autumn leaves tinted toward your theme's colors tumble down the sides of the screen on a gentle breeze, thin out behind the chat, and lift in an updraft while the cursor moves.

canvasFx.name: Firefly Meadow
canvasFx.description: Fireflies blink in short bursts over swaying grass and ground mist under a crescent moon; now and then one flashes a J-shaped mating arc, a tap sends the nearest one on its own, and the cursor turns the breeze.

canvasFx.name: Fluid Ribbons
canvasFx.description: Twisting silk ribbons in the theme's accent colors wander the outer thirds of the screen, glow softly where they cross, lean toward a moving cursor and fade to a whisper over the chat column.

canvasFx.name: Glitch Grid
canvasFx.description: A faint HUD grid with drafting measurements at its edges, where cells, scan lines and blocks glitch now and then in the outer thirds, away from the chat.

canvasFx.name: Ink Bloom
canvasFx.description: Drops of ink in the theme's accent colors bloom and diffuse in the outer thirds of the screen with soft tide-line edges, fading out over the chat column; the cursor stirs them and a tap lets a drop fall.

canvasFx.name: Iridescent Liquid Glass (WebGL)
canvasFx.description: Domain-warped veins of thin-film glass in your theme's accents fold slowly at the screen's edges, thin behind the chat, brighten under the cursor and ripple where you tap.

canvasFx.name: Koi Pond (WebGL)
canvasFx.description: A clear pond seen from above, tinted by your theme, where koi glide along its edges under lily pads and caustic light, follow a nearby cursor, scatter from a tap's ripple and now and then kiss the surface.

canvasFx.name: Lava Lamp
canvasFx.description: Soft blobs in your theme's colors warm at the bottom, rise, cool and sink again like a lava lamp, glowing where they meet, thinning behind the chat and drifting toward the cursor.

canvasFx.name: Liquid Chrome (WebGL)
canvasFx.description: A domain-warped pool of liquid chrome tinted by your theme that gathers at the screen's edges and corners, leaves the chat clear and leans toward the cursor.

canvasFx.name: Living Sky
canvasFx.description: Follows your local time: the sun or a phase-correct moon rides an arc in an outer third over layered mountains, with horizon glow, drifting clouds, night stars and a theme tint.

canvasFx.name: Matrix Rain
canvasFx.description: Classic digital rain of Latin, katakana or mixed glyphs in your theme's accent, with glowing heads, fading trails, a calm chat column, and faster streams near the cursor.

canvasFx.name: Molten Forge (WebGL)
canvasFx.description: Domain-warped lava rivers glow through cracked crust along the screen's sides and floor with rising embers, cooling to faint cracks behind the chat while the cursor stokes the heat and leans the flow.

canvasFx.name: Aether Nebula (WebGL)
canvasFx.description: Domain-warped nebula gas in your theme's accent colors that gathers at the screen's edges, thins behind the chat, parts around the cursor and now and then blooms.

canvasFx.name: Neural Network
canvasFx.description: Layers of drifting nodes linked by faint connections, with pulses of light that travel between them and set off cascades, sent by the cursor and by a tap.

canvasFx.name: Ocean Waves
canvasFx.description: Layered translucent swells in your theme's colors roll across the lower screen with lit crests, rising bubbles and drifting caustic light, thin behind the chat and lift under the cursor.

canvasFx.name: Parallax Vista (WebGL)
canvasFx.description: Layered dusk mountain ranges open into a valley behind the chat, a soft sun glows beside it, mist pools in the folds and fireflies drift past, every layer shifting by its depth as the cursor moves.

canvasFx.name: Plasma Flow (WebGPU)
canvasFx.description: Domain-warped plasma currents in your theme's accent colors, drawn with a WebGPU shader (soft drifting color blobs where WebGPU is missing), that thin behind the chat and bend toward the cursor with a fading glow.

canvasFx.name: Retro Sun
canvasFx.description: A synthwave sun with scrolling stripe cutouts sets low in an outer third over a perspective grid that rolls toward you, under calm twinkling stars; the glow swells when the cursor comes near.

canvasFx.name: Rose Window (WebGL)
canvasFx.description: A cathedral rose window of mirrored Voronoi glass in your theme's accents glows in the margin beside the chat, lit by a slow sunbeam that the cursor tilts, with dust motes drifting in the light.

canvasFx.name: Sandstorm
canvasFx.description: Sand grains stream sideways at varied depths over low dunes, thickening as soft gust waves roll through; the sand thins behind the chat and parts around the cursor.

canvasFx.name: Snow Globe
canvasFx.description: Snow in three depths drifts down the sides of the screen on a slow breeze, a few large flakes turn as crystals and glint, a moving cursor swirls the flakes, and a thin drift settles along the bottom edge.

canvasFx.name: Solar Tide (WebGL)
canvasFx.description: A sun and moon follow your local time along an arc in the margin beside the chat, laying a glitter path on a calm sea below, with dawn and dusk glow on the horizon and stars at night.

canvasFx.name: Tactical Liquid Grid
canvasFx.description: A field of crosshairs that the cursor shoves aside like elastic fabric, lighting up in your theme's accents as they spring back, faded behind the chat.

canvasFx.name: Tap Fireworks
canvasFx.description: Tap anywhere to burst a firework in your theme's accent colors, quick taps on one spot build bigger bursts, and small rockets go up beside the chat column while you rest.

canvasFx.name: Terminator (WebGL)
canvasFx.description: A slowly turning planet beside the chat whose daylight follows your local time, with a warm sunset line, city lights on the night side, drifting clouds, an atmosphere halo and faint stars; moving the cursor across it nudges its spin.

canvasFx.name: The Genesis Lattice
canvasFx.description: Conway's Game of Life drawn as a breathing 3D mesh of glowing nodes and bonds in the theme's accent colors, dense at the screen's edges and faint over the chat column; the cursor sows new life and tilts the mesh.

canvasFx.name: Thunderhead (WebGL)
canvasFx.description: Domain-warped storm clouds with silver edges churn across the top of the screen over slanted rain; lightning now and then tears down beside the chat column, sometimes twice, and sweeping the cursor sideways gusts the wind.

canvasFx.name: Thunderstorm
canvasFx.description: Slanting rain at three depths under drifting cloud banks, with branching lightning that strikes beside the chat column above a low city skyline; tap to call a strike.

canvasFx.name: Topographic Map
canvasFx.description: Contour lines and soft elevation fills over slowly flowing terrain in your theme's colors, fading behind the chat column; the cursor raises a gentle hill that settles once it stops.

canvasFx.name: Total Eclipse (WebGL)
canvasFx.description: A black moon beside the chat wreathed in a slowly flowing corona with a thin red chromosphere and faint stars; now and then a diamond-ring flare lights its outer rim, and the cursor gently parallaxes the scene.

canvasFx.name: Voronoi Prism (WebGL)
canvasFx.description: Two layers of drifting stained-glass Voronoi cells tinted with your theme's accents, fading behind the chat, with edges that flare under the cursor.

canvasFx.name: Voxel Flyover (WebGL)
canvasFx.description: A calm glide over an endless block world of grass, stone, snow, sand and flat water that fades into your theme's background with distance and behind the chat, under a pixel-square sun; the camera leans toward the cursor.
